The Beta Transformed Lomax distribution

Source: R/BTL.R
BTL.Rd

The Beta Transformed Lomax family

Usage

BTL(mu.link = "log", sigma.link = "log", nu.link = "log")

Arguments

mu.link

defines the mu.link, with "log" link as the default for the mu parameter.

sigma.link

defines the sigma.link, with "log" link as the default for the sigma parameter.

nu.link

defines the nu.link, with "log" link as the default for the nu parameter.

Value

Returns a gamlss.family object which can be used to fit a BTL distribution in the gamlss() function.

Details

The Beta Transformed Lomax distribution with parameters mu, sigma and nu has density given by

\(f(x) = \frac{\log \nu}{\nu-1} \frac{\sigma}{\mu} \left(1+\frac{x}{\mu}\right)^{-(\sigma+1)} \nu^{\left(1+\frac{x}{\mu}\right)^{-\sigma}},\)

for \(\nu \neq 1\), and for \(\nu = 1\):

\(f(x) = \frac{\sigma}{\mu} \left(1+\frac{x}{\mu}\right)^{-(\sigma+1)},\)

for \(x \geq 0\), \(\mu > 0\), \(\sigma > 0\) and \(\nu > 0\).

References

Kottakkunnan, F. A New Generalization of Lomax Distribution: Estimation and Modelling for Medical Data. J Stat Theory Appl 25, 19 (2026). https://doi.org/10.1007/s44199-026-00171-0

See also

dBTL

Author

Marieth Guillen, mguillen@unal.edu.co

Examples

# Example 1
# Generating some random values with
# known mu and sigma

hist(rnorm(1000))
